missing_fact: Does a record kept by someone other than the norm-maker, the executor or the self-asserting ruling attest the norm state of a register target at a stated t? In practice: a host-side record (required checks or branch protection, PR approvals, CI run history, audit log), or a verified host-generated signature tied to one. Concrete instance: was WP-4C-1 authorized or blocked at 2026-08-04T00:30:25Z?
